entities.name: Ludwik Ćwikliński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludwik Ćwikliński was a Polish classical philologist, professor and rector of Lviv University (1893–1894), editor of "Eos" magazine (1894–1901). Between 1899 and 1902 he was a member of the Austrian parliament, and he was the Austrian Minister of Education between 1917 and 1918.
